description:
## Why
`IO.inspect(~s(hi))` fails with parse/expected-token: unsupported expression prefix in compiler2 front door: Sigil("s"), with or without parentheses. The lexer emits Tok::Sigil (src/parser/lexer.rs), but Parser::parse_prefix (src/compiler2/frontdoor.rs) has no arm for it, so no sigil is an expression. Elixir code uses ~s, ~w, ~c and ~r widely. Found while narrowing fz-nhb.2.

## What changes
A sigil is an expression with Elixir's delimiters, interpolation rules and modifiers, for the sigils fz's library can answer. Which sigils are in scope is decided when this ticket is planned.

## Signal
Oracle fixtures for each supported sigil match Elixir on run, interp and build.
